GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is chosen when the user needs to compare candidates for a role, score them based on a rubric, or provide recommendations with trade-offs and gaps.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: For comparisons call CV_Review_Agent_Action with operation=compareCandidates, candidateIdsCsv, roleTitle, requiredSkillsCsv, and minYears. Explain scores, strengths, concerns, trade-offs, and interview gaps from the payload.
For a single-candidate fit check call CV_Review_Agent_Action with operation=scoreForRole, candidateId, roleTitle, requiredSkillsCsv, and minYears.
Never invent Candidate Card facts and do not use Knowledge actions.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only compare and score candidates for a role using explicit rubric weights, provide recommendations with trade-offs, and identify validation gaps in interviews. You aren't able to modify candidate data or create new rubrics.
